events.event: BEI cuts the lower auto-rejection limit (ARB) to an asymmetric 7% for all stocks priced above Rp10, effective 19 October through 31 December 2026, with OJK support, after Friday's crash.
events.key_numbers: ARB 15% → 7% (price tiers Rp11–200, >Rp200–5,000, >Rp5,000) · Rp1–10 tier unchanged at Rp1 · SK Kep-00157/BEI/10-2026 replaces Kep-00136/BEI/09-2026 · valid 19 Oct–31 Dec 2026, then re-evaluated · IHSG fell 11.57% to 5,185.11 on 16 Oct, largest one-day drop since 1998
events.why_it_matters: A saham can now fall at most 7% a day instead of 15%, which slows panic selling but also traps retail investors who want to exit.

events.event: IHSG week of 12-16 Oct: index lost 14.91% in one week, with the 16 Oct close (-11.57%) the biggest one-day fall since the 1998 crisis; banks fell about 15% in a single session.
events.key_numbers: Weekly -14.91% from 6,093.76 (9 Oct) to 5,185.10 (derived) · 16 Oct: -11.57%, intraday low 5,185.11, high 5,404.51, 812 fell / 11 rose / 140 unchanged · record one-day fall 8 Jan 1998 was -11.95% · BBCA -14.81% to Rp5,175, BBRI -14.84% to Rp2,640, BMRI -14.82% to Rp3,390, BBNI -12.90% to Rp2,970 · foreign net sell on 16 Oct: BBCA Rp2.3 T, BBRI Rp1.1 T, BMRI Rp868 miliar · foreign YTD net sell Rp110.7 T (big four banks about Rp68 T; BBCA about Rp34.4 T) per RTI · market value of about Rp1,000 T reportedly erased within an hour (headline only)
events.why_it_matters: Savings and pension funds that hold bank shares lost about a seventh of their value in five trading days.

events.event: OJK imposes Rp2.1 trillion in administrative fines on DSSA (alleged planned stock manipulation 2023-2026), BREN and CUAN (alleged IPO allocations to affiliates under concealed identities), the same afternoon the IHSG crashed.
events.key_numbers: DSSA Rp1.5 T · BREN Rp500 miliar · CUAN Rp100 miliar · total Rp2.1 T · DSSA probe summoned ≥12 securities directors, 15 individuals, 11 foreign entities · BREN/CUAN IPO probe: 4 underwriters, 3 custodian banks · Articles 91, 92 (DSSA) and 107 (BREN/CUAN) of the Capital Markets Law · a securities-company director's licence frozen · OJK sanctioned 835 parties Jan–mid-Oct 2026, total >Rp390 miliar · OJK says the fines come from an ongoing examination, not only recent market moves
events.why_it_matters: These are exactly the 'coordinated trading' and 'opaque ownership' issues MSCI cited, so the fines show why foreign index providers are worried.

events.event: OJK and the exchange SROs hold a Sunday 'consolidation dialogue' at BEI with analysts, economists, market players and finfluencers; BEI says it was caught off guard by MSCI and lists reform and fundamentals data in rebuttal.
events.key_numbers: BEI, OJK and Danantara met MSCI and other index providers in Bangkok on 13 Oct with no warning signal · MSCI usually announces its review in early November (around 12 Nov), this came about a month earlier · disclosure threshold cut 5% → 1% · investor categories 9 → 39, published monthly on the 2nd · high-shareholding-concentration (HSC) board now covers market cap >Rp5 T (was Rp10 T), HSC stocks removed from LQ45, IDX30, IDX80 · tick size 50 → 1 from 28 Sep 2026 · short selling introduced · Q2 2026 GDP 5.29% · listed-company June revenue +15.94%, net income +16.25% · 74% of issuers profitable · P/E 9.4x vs Singapore 18.5x · market cap US$589 B (2nd in ASEAN) · 31.1 M investors (11.0% of population) · BEI says FTSE Russell kept Indonesia as secondary emerging and removed it from its Watch List in Oct 2026 (single-source claim)
events.why_it_matters: Regulators are arguing that Indonesia's company earnings are strong and only the market structure is the problem, which is the core of the debate over the crash.

events.event: BEI plans a virtual meeting with MSCI on the afternoon of 19 October to seek clarification of the Standalone proposal, followed by a press conference; institutional investors plan their own clarification calls.
events.key_numbers: Zoom meeting afternoon 19 Oct (time not given) · BEI press conference to follow · MSCI feedback deadline 30 Apr 2027 · final decision by 30 Jun 2027
events.why_it_matters: Whatever BEI says after the call can move the market tomorrow morning, so it decides how the story reads in the next video.

events.event: Rupiah closes above Rp18,000 per USD on risk-off over the MSCI proposal; Bank Indonesia says it is intervening in NDF, spot, DNDF and buying SBN in the secondary market.
events.key_numbers: Spot close Rp18,025/USD (-87 pts, -0.49%, Doo Financial Futures) · morning level Rp18,073 (-135 pts, -0.75%) · BI forex reserves US$146.3 B end-Sep 2026 · Bisnis short-term range forecast Rp18,000–18,200 · most Asian currencies strengthened that day (KRW +0.66%)
events.why_it_matters: A weaker rupiah makes imported fuel, food and gadgets pricier for ordinary households.

events.event: Forbes-based figures reported by Bisnis show Prajogo Pangestu's net worth falling to about US$11.4 billion from US$39.8 billion at end-2025, as Barito-group stocks collapse; his affiliated issuers also plan buybacks of up to Rp2.5 trillion through December.
events.key_numbers: Net worth US$39.8 B (end-2025) → US$11.4 B (about Rp205.5 T at Rp18,027), down about US$28 B / Rp504 T · BREN market cap Rp1,297 T (end-2025) → Rp387.98 T (Sep) → Rp248.17 T now, share price Rp1,855, -80.88% YTD (peak Rp9,700) · CUAN Rp60.7 T, -76.92% YTD · Barito group Rp610.65 T = 6.66% of IDX market cap · Robert Budi Hartono US$13.2 B (Forbes Real Time, 18 Oct), Prajogo now second · buyback up to Rp2.5 T by BREN, CUAN, BRPT through end-Dec 2026 (headline only)
events.why_it_matters: It shows how much of the index's value sat in a few tightly held conglomerate stocks.

events.event: Bank Indonesia holds its quarterly RDG on 20-21 October with the BI-Rate decision due on the second day (21 October), under rupiah above Rp18,000 and market turmoil.
events.key_numbers: BI-Rate 5.75% (held 23 Sep, highest since Apr 2025) · decision/press conference 21 Oct · bank credit growth data also due 21 Oct · M2 money supply due 23 Oct · next RDG 17-18 Nov (announcement 18 Nov) · BI forex reserves US$146.3 B (end-Sep) · September inflation 3.28% y/y · economist consensus for this meeting not found
events.why_it_matters: A rate hike would defend the rupiah but make mortgages and business loans costlier; a hold risks a weaker rupiah.

events.event: US Fed meets 28 October after September minutes showed a majority of officials favouring another rate hike before year-end, with US Treasury yields at their highest since 2002.
events.key_numbers: FOMC 28 Oct and 9 Dec 2026 · 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike in 2026 · core PCE Aug 3.0% y/y, headline PCE 3.4% y/y (target 2%) · Treasury yields highest since 2002 · current fed funds level not stated in source
events.why_it_matters: Higher US rates pull money out of emerging markets such as Indonesia and pressure the rupiah on top of the MSCI worry.

events.event: Brent climbs to about US$108 per barrel, the highest since mid-September, with Hormuz flows well below normal and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia adding to supply fears.
events.key_numbers: Brent $108.28 on 16 Oct, up more than 5% on the week, below $109 on 18 Oct (Trading Economics stream) · Brent $106.65 and WTI $93.74 on 12 Oct (Reuters via KabarBursa) · Hormuz flows 11.62 M bpd in week to 13 Oct vs 17.15 M baseline · Houthi missile attack on Riyadh airport 10 Oct reportedly killed 13 · EIA Q4 2026 Brent forecast about $105; Goldman Dec 2026 forecast $90 · Pertamina kept October fuel prices unchanged
events.why_it_matters: Oil above US$100 and a weak rupiah squeeze Pertamina and the budget, raising the odds of higher fuel prices later.

events.event: BPS reported the August 2026 trade surplus on 1 October; BPS now publishes trade data at the start of the month, so the scheduled 15 October September release (E0023) does not exist and September data is expected around early November.
events.key_numbers: Aug 2026 surplus US$3.55 B · exports US$26.61 B (+6.72% y/y) · imports US$23.06 B (+19.09% y/y) · Jan–Aug surplus US$7.25 B, exports US$193.64 B (+4.74%), imports US$186.39 B (+19.84%) · July 2026 surplus US$120 juta after two deficit months · September release date inferred, not confirmed
events.why_it_matters: Imports growing about 19% a year while exports grow under 5% is why the trade surplus keeps shrinking and the rupiah lacks support.

events.event: Kemenkeu reports the September 2026 APBN deficit at Rp319 trillion (1.24% of GDP), and Menkeu Suahasil Nazara says the budget is on track for a year-end deficit near 2.8%.
events.key_numbers: Deficit Rp319 T = 1.24% of GDP (0.9% in Aug) vs full-year target Rp689.1 T (2.68%) · revenue Rp2,341.5 T = 74.2% of target, +25.5% y/y · tax Rp1,847.7 T · PNBP Rp492.3 T · spending Rp2,660.5 T = 69.2%, +19% y/y · primary balance surplus Rp125.5 T · year-end deficit projection about 2.8% · deficit 14.13% lower than Sep 2025 (Rp371.5 T)
events.why_it_matters: The year-end projection of 2.8% is close to the legal 3% ceiling, which matters for rating agencies and SBN yields.

events.event: OJK sanctioned 35 multifinance, 8 venture capital, 8 P2P-lending (pinjol) and 18 pawn companies in September 2026.
events.key_numbers: 69 entities (35 + 8 + 8 + 18) · 33 fines · 112 written warnings · period September 2026, reported 5 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Pinjol and multifinance sanctions matter more now that default risk among borrowers is rising.

events.event: Indonesia sets higher CPO reference price for October 2026 and a slightly lower first-half-October coal reference price (HBA).
events.key_numbers: CPO reference US$1,042.15/t (+US$34.64, +3.44% from US$1,007.51) · CPO export duty US$178/t · export levy 12.5% (about US$130.27/t) · HBA (6,322 kcal) US$122.52/t vs 123.54 · HBA I US$90.60 vs 93.94 · HBA II US$63.45 vs 63.17 · HBA III US$43.84 vs 44.53 · Kepmen ESDM 384.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2026
events.why_it_matters: These reference prices set export duties and royalties, which feed state revenue from palm oil and coal.
